basic_info.description: Beautiful, updated, 2nd story, 1,200-sq.-ft., unfurnished, 2 bedrooms, 1-bathroom, Edwardian Condo in a 3-unit building in the Lower Haight available October 1st. Original built-ins, Edwardian moldings, hardwood floor, and decorative brick fireplace. Recently renovated large, eat-in kitchen with plenty of cabinet/pantry space. Stainless steel appliances. Dishwasher, garbage disposal, refrigerator, freezer, oven/ range, and microwave. Granite countertops. Updated 3-piece bathroom. Large Master bedroom with walk-in closet. 2nd bedroom also has a good-sized closet space. Hardwood floors throughout. 2 hall closets for storage. Access to a balcony overlooking the backyard from both bedrooms. Washer and dryer in unit. Water and Trash included. Forced-air for heating as the units climate control. Large shared backyard surrounded by a lawn, gardens and redwood trees. No worries, the landlord will take care of the yard. Only cats are allowed with a $500 pet deposit/pet.
